record.title: Recover the guest breakpoint clear and rearm contract
record.intent: Explain the observed clear readback using pinned reference code and select a bounded delivery test.
requirements: Preserve the negative group-remaining-init-01 capture and executable without adapting that experiment.
Inspect and pin upstream ARM64 debug regset encoding breakpoint creation validation and attribute update ordering; distinguish reference explanation from actual guest behavior.
Define exact initial clear armed clear and rearm readback hypotheses including metadata type length privilege and unused slots.
Require actual checkpoint delivery atomic progress and old-site revisit to evaluate rotation; do not equate a cached enable bit with installed hardware state.
Keep the recovered ADC SPU SCU transport and LA contract fixed and introduce no new modeled response or device path.
acceptance: A reviewable bounded profile and its limits are committed and pushed before new guest execution.
